title: 富兰克林邓普顿Larry：AI领域信贷利差走阔，美联储压力减轻？
speaker: Larry Hathaway

segments.en: Yeah, I mean, you mentioned how financial conditions have tightened.
segments.zh: 是的，你提到金融条件已经收紧。

segments.en: Just given what we've seen in this correction in AI, when you talk about credit spreads that are widening, do you think that's already kind of done some of the work
segments.zh: 鉴于我们在AI领域看到的这次调整，当你说信贷利差扩大时，你认为这已经为美联储分担了一些压力吗？
拉里，这对美联储来说已经起到一些作用了吗？

segments.en: I think it is doing some of the work for the Fed.
segments.zh: 我认为这确实在为美联储分担一些压力。

segments.en: I think the Fed is a little reluctant to kind of fully acknowledge that at this point in time.
segments.zh: 我认为美联储目前有点不愿意完全承认这一点。

segments.en: But I do think that those two areas of the economy, I mentioned, namely housing being one, which has been chronically weak for other reasons.
segments.zh: 但我确实认为，我提到的经济中的两个领域， namely 住房领域，由于其他原因一直长期疲软。

segments.en: But it's obviously not helped by the fact that mortgage rates have backed up to the levels that we see today over 7% for 30-year conventional mortgages.
segments.zh: 但显然，30年期常规抵押贷款利率已回升至今天看到的7%以上的水平，这对住房领域没有帮助。

segments.en: And then, again, back to the credit spread widening that we've seen affect some parts of the AI sector.
segments.zh: 然后，再次回到我们看到的信贷利差扩大，这影响了AI领域的某些部分。

segments.en: I think those two things probably mean that there will be summary strength exerted by capital markets on the economy.
segments.zh: 我认为这两件事可能意味着资本市场将对经济施加一定的下行压力。

segments.en: And bear in mind, the big driver for growth has been capital expenditures.
segments.zh: 记住，增长的主要驱动力一直是资本支出。

segments.en: A lot of it in the AI space. That rate of growth is set to slow for a variety of reasons.
segments.zh: 很多集中在人工智能领域。由于多种原因，这一增速将会放缓。

segments.en: But one of them simply being base effects. We are now compounding off of a much higher level of expenditures in that space.
segments.zh: 但其中一个原因仅仅是基数效应。我们现在是在该领域支出水平大幅提高的基础上进行复合增长。

segments.en: We're seeing cash flows begin to turn negative at some of the larger firms that are engaged in that build out.
segments.zh: 我们看到，一些参与该领域建设的大型企业现金流开始转为负值。

segments.en: For all those sorts of reasons, I think, there's some built-in deceleration that's going to take place, which will help the Fed kind of navigate
segments.zh: 由于所有这些原因，我认为将出现一些内在的减速，这将有助于美联储

segments.en: through things without the need for significant for the rate hikes.
segments.zh: 应对局面，而无需大幅加息。
